name: HEIC for Jelly
description: Makes HEIC/HEIF photos visible and renderable in a Jellyfin photo library.
overview: Adds HEIC support to photo libraries.
changelog: Jellyfin 12 support confirmed. The same build runs on Jellyfin 10.11.6 and 12.4, verified on a real library: every HEIC resolves, renders and keeps its EXIF identically on both. Jellyfin 12's ffmpeg 8.1 can also open HEICs that ffmpeg 7 rejects. No change in behaviour on 10.11. Requires Jellyfin 10.11.6 or later and ffmpeg 7.0 or newer.
